The quarterly review shows far too many standing super admins in the identity provider. Bring the admin group down to what is actually approved, and close this ticket with a note of what changed.

items.title: Privileged access standard - identity provider administrators
items.body: Standing membership of IdP Super Admins is limited to the approved roster recorded as evidence on compliance control IAM-07. Temporary elevation is allowed only through an approved change, and the membership must carry the change's expiry date. The break-glass account must always remain a member and must never be disabled. When removing someone from the admin group, remove only the admin membership - their normal access is unaffected.
